run_from: the repository root, on the RTX 4080 machine
what_it_does: downloads and checks the pinned TinyStories sample; saves 4 initial states and 4 data orders; times 50 steps; fixes the step count for ~5 min/run; writes the manifest; runs 16 runs seed-major in fresh processes; resumable by re-running the same command

estimate.total_hours_with_setup: about 1.4 to 1.6 (download ~260 MB and conversion, probe, 16 runs of ~5 min)
estimate.basis: 6 N D plus explicit attention FLOPs; throughput assumed, not measured (no GPU here); the launcher's own probe sets the real step count and aborts if the projection exceeds --max-hours (default 2.5)

requirements.install: pip install torch numpy pyarrow  (use the CUDA build of torch for your driver)
requirements.gpu: RTX 4080 (16 GB); peak memory well under 4 GB
requirements.network: huggingface.co for the pinned TinyStories files
requirements.os: Linux or Windows; the launcher sets CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG itself

outputs.runs: results/crn/pilot/runs/lr{0.5,0.75,1,1.5}_seed{0..3}.json (eval loss at step 0 and 10 checkpoints, hashes)

validated_here: CPU, toy size (tests/test_crn_pilot.py): identical configuration reproduces the loss curve exactly; step-0 parameter hashes identical across the four learning rates per seed index; batch sequence identical across the four learning rates per seed index; analysis decision logic on synthetic runs. Not validated here: CUDA determinism and the full-size runs.
